canonical_envelope.wire_form: UTF-8 JSON object serialized in exact lexicographic key order with no insignificant whitespace: {"lineage_validity":<boolean>,"observation":<token>,"state":<token>}

decoder_pipeline.rule: Strict UTF-8 decode; failure -> F_MALFORMED_ENCODING; mutation=false.
Parse exactly one JSON object with a duplicate-key-rejecting parser; syntax error, non-object, duplicate key, or trailing token -> F_MALFORMED_OBJECT; mutation=false.
Require exact key set {lineage_validity,observation,state}; any missing or unknown key -> F_MALFORMED_FIELDS; mutation=false.
Require state and observation to be JSON strings and lineage_validity to be a JSON boolean; otherwise -> F_MALFORMED_TYPES; mutation=false.
Require state in {U,C,A_t,F_t} and observation in {P,S,A_o,O}; otherwise -> F_MALFORMED_TOKEN; mutation=false.
Reserialize the parsed value with the canonical serializer and require byte-for-byte equality with the persisted input; mismatch -> F_NONCANONICAL_ENCODING; mutation=false.
Only a D0-D5-valid envelope is converted to one-hot state/observation plus boolean lineage_validity and passed to predecessor validator V0-V6 and guards G1-G11.

proofs.decoder_determinism: Each input byte string has exactly one outcome: the first failing D0-D5 rule, or one unique canonical typed triple. Duplicate keys cannot be silently overwritten because D1 rejects them, and D5 removes representational aliases such as alternate key order or whitespace.
proofs.malformed_sink_totality: Missing, duplicate, unknown, mistyped, out-of-domain, syntactically invalid, non-UTF-8, trailing, or merely non-canonical persisted inputs terminate without mutation before V0-V6 or any semantic guard. Thus all decoder-invalid inputs are fail-closed.
proofs.terminal_absorption: A valid canonical envelope whose state token is A_t or F_t reaches predecessor V1/V2 and stutters terminally before observation/lineage semantics can enable a mutation. Any malformed envelope, including one that merely contains a terminal-looking token in an invalid structure, is rejected earlier and cannot reopen the terminal.
proofs.no_cas_on_invalid: CAS1/CAS2 are reachable only after D0-D6 succeeds, V0-V6 validates the one-hot triple, and the existing exact semantic guards match. Every decoder-invalid input exits with mutation=false, so the decoder cannot create a new CAS path.
proofs.canonical_replay_identity: Because D5 accepts one wire representation per typed triple, replay identity can be defined by the canonical bytes (or a later digest of them) without ambiguity from JSON aliases. This does not itself solve external effect acknowledgement or ABA/lineage binding.
